svg.title: The Norway Problem: your YAML turned NO into false and I have the table
svg.desc: Three YAML key:value lines feed a coercion column: bare "yes" flips a toggle on to true, "NO" flips a toggle off to false, and version 1.20 is a chip shedding its trailing zero as a falling dot. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The Norway Problem: your YAML turned NO into false and I have the table”. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 1967480166.
